items.title: A distinguished triangle expressing a complex as the pushforward of its cohomology with support plus the derived pushforward of its restriction to the open complement
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the sheaf-level distinguished triangle i_* R-H_Z(K) -> K -> Rj_*(K|_U) -> i_*R-H_Z(K)[1] in D(O_X) for a closed subset Z with open complement U. The proof chooses a K-injective complex with injective terms representing K, recalls that its restriction to U stays K-injective so that all three derived functors are computed from it, and thereby reduces the triangle to the short exact sequence 0 -> i_*H_Z(I) -> I -> j_*(I|_U) -> 0 for a single injective module I (proof lines 8669-8682). The exactness is then read off the cited surjectivity statement and the definitions (proof lines 8683-8684). H2: the parallel treatment of the sections triangle at S11-coh-triangle-support does not shorten this proof, and the reduction to a single short exact sequence of injective modules is the substance.
